notes.title: New Version 1.4
notes.notes:
- 30% more character health
- More burgers and bottles on the first levels

notes.title: New Version 1.3. Release Notes:
notes.notes:
- The character doesn’t stagger so much when walking.
- Added a burger and a bottle to level 3.
- Made level 2 design more obvious.

notes.title: New Version 1.2. Release Notes:
notes.notes:
- Added detailed help / tutorial
- More energy
- More responsive controls
- Added hamburgers and bottles to level 2 and 3
- I returned the fall from a long run. It's fun dudes!

notes.title: New Version 1.1. Release Notes
notes.notes:
- Fixed the main menu. Click the “Continue Game” button to play!
- Added a hint. Move List.
- Removed random fall.
- Character stopping faster 
- Fixed a bug with the disappearance of opponents.
